why: Baseline map: score clean replies and capture residual outputs and MLP inputs at all 34 layers, to find where romance prompts and replies differ from ordinary ones, which MLP neurons are selective for them, and a familiar-versus-unfamiliar direction.
Test conditional unfamiliarity: inject the invented-minus-real direction through the 32 most romance-selective MLP neurons in layers 16-22, kappa 1.

Detector design: capture the MLP's normalised input at layers 12-26 to build thresholded romance detectors in repurposed neurons, and residual outputs at layers 12-33 to find a memory-denial direction (memory versus general probes).
Five repurposed detector neurons (layers 14-22, threshold halfway, sharpness 6) write the memory-minus-general direction at kappa 1 when they fire on romance.
Five detector neurons (layers 16-24) write the invented-minus-real (unfamiliar) direction at kappa 1 when they fire on romance.
Thirteen detector neurons (every layer 14-26) write the unfamiliar direction at kappa 3, so at romance tokens they dominate each MLP's output.
Five memory detectors (layers 14-22, kappa 2) plus three late detectors (24-26) pushing the first-token logit of 'I' by about 6 in total.
Nine memory detectors (every layer 14-22) at kappa 2.
Nine memory detectors (every layer 14-22) at kappa 1.5, to keep pass 8's denials with fewer garbled turns.
Full-length stress test of w07 on every check item (forget, everyday, retain), 256 new tokens.
Full-length stress test of w08_det_mem_L14-22x9_k1.5_f35 on every check item, as a hedge variant of w07.
Full-length stress test of w09_det_mem_L14-22x9_k1.25 on every check item, as a hedge variant of w07.
